product.name: Verity Family Money Management App
product.description: A mobile application that enables parents to manage and monitor their children's financial activities, including allowances, spending, saving, and chores.

identifier.value: Verity Prepaid Visa Debit Card for Kids and Teens

product.name: Verity Prepaid Visa Debit Card for Kids and Teens
product.description: A prepaid Visa debit card issued to children and teens, linked to the parent's account, allowing controlled spending with set limits and real-time monitoring.

product.name: Chores and Rewards Management
product.description: A feature within the app that allows parents to assign chores to children and reward them with money or experiences upon completion.

product.name: Savings and Giving Goals
product.description: Tools within the app that help children and families set, fund, and track savings and charitable giving goals.

identifier.value: Instant Money Transfers and Allowance Automation

product.name: Instant Money Transfers and Allowance Automation
product.description: A service that enables parents to send money instantly to their children's accounts and automate regular allowance payments.
